$comment: Produced by tools/conformance.py from the Rust CLI, which is the reference implementation. Regenerate with --generate only when a change to ordering is intended: regenerating to make a test pass would destroy the only thing the suite exists to check. See CONTRIBUTING.md section 5.1.

ancestors-province.why: a level-2 area: ancestors are [province, country]

ancestors-settlement.why: a settlement under a province and country: three levels deep, zero recursive queries

children-of-city.why: keyset pagination ordering, which is name-then-id

country-de.why: Deutschland, and the capital is resolved

country-jp.why: 日本; also a package whose postal data exists despite the spec's assumption otherwise

country-tr.why: the display name is Türkiye, not GeoNames' English Turkey

localized-tr-japanese.why: cross-language lookup: イスタンブール

localized-tr-turkish.why: the everyday short form, not the formal Republic of Türkiye

nearest-antalya.unavailable: the CLI exposes no nearest query
nearest-antalya.why: haversine ordering computed in SDK code, from R*Tree candidates

postal-multi-area.why: a code covering a district AND its city; areas must be a list and order must be stable

search-antalya.why: exact and prefix matches with different levels; the province and the city share a name

search-byzantion.why: the German historic name; a different script and length through the same index

search-constantinople.why: a historic name from place_alternate_names; reaches Istanbul through the index

search-istanbul-dotless-i.why: Turkish dotted/dotless I folding, normalization section 8's headline case

search-istanbul-dotted-i.why: the same place from the other spelling; must reach an identical result set

search-katakana-istanbul.why: a Japanese exonym in the Turkish package; dakuten must survive normalization

search-nonexistent.why: an empty result set must be empty in every implementation, not an error

search-prefix-only.why: the everyday form, with the Turkish ş; normalization section 8

search-three-char-cjk.why: three characters, so the trigram index serves it

search-two-char-cjk.why: documented limitation: below the trigram floor, so it returns nothing. Asserted so the limitation cannot be silently 'fixed' into a scan

searchcity-antalya.why: type filtering: the province must not appear
